content.text:
server.servlet.context-path=/xplan-validator-api
spring.rabbitmq.username=${XPLAN_RABBIT_USER:guest}
springdoc.api-docs.enabled=true
springdoc.enable-default-api-docs=false
springdoc.swagger-ui.path=/
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[0].url=/api/v2
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[0].name=Validator API V2
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[1].url=/xvalidator/api/v1
springdoc.swagger-ui.urls[1].name=Validator API V1 (deprecated)
springdoc.swagger-ui.urlsPrimaryName=Validator API V2
xplanbox.rabbitmq.public.topic.name=${XPLAN_RABBIT_PUBLIC_TOPIC:}
xplanbox.rabbitmq.private.topic.name=${XPLAN_RABBIT_PRIVATE_TOPIC:xplanbox-private}
server.servlet.context-path=/xplan-dokumente-api
springdoc.api-docs.enabled=true
springdoc.enable-default-api-docs=false
springdoc.swagger-ui.path=/
xplanbox.database.username=${XPLAN_DB_USER}
